svg.title: Adaptive investigator · bounded native graph
svg.desc: Each active turn chooses after earlier tool results. Unused slots after commitment make no model calls.
svg.text: 20 native nodes · 90 declared dependencies · arrows point to the consumer
Lab: cutoff feed → up to eight adaptive action/result pairs → canonical all-target commitment.
Review receives actual execution and later outcomes through a separately frozen feed.
Study coordinator replays both procedures and supplies the measured result to the next review.
Runtime inputs may still be required.
Runtime inputs may still be required.
TOOL: source or deterministic operation REASONING: model operator Green: frozen Lab/Oracle checkpoints
Repeated cards name the same artifact. Each declared edge appears once; no skip edges are omitted.
Research prototype. Scaffold bounds differ from each run's exported execution graph.
